pages.text: The Chishi Upgrade Station spends Chi Energy, Upgrade Templates and upgrade slots to apply advanced upgrades (special abilities) to Chishi gear:$(br2)$(li)20M Chi + 1 Upgrade Template + 1 upgrade slot per upgrade$(li)Lifesteal: heal 1 HP per hit per level$(li)Knockback Resistance: +0.1 per level$(li)Move Speed: +2% per level$(li)Fire Resistance: -15% fire damage per level$(li)Blast Protection: -15% explosion damage per level$(li)Fall Protection: -15% fall damage per level$(li)Max 3 levels per ability per piece (damage reduction caps at 90%)$(br2)Upgrade slots start at 4 from the Forger; plan your ability build.
